One night of no sleep is not a reason to skip on its own, but it is a reason to dial it back. Your reaction time, coordination and grip are all worse, so heavy singles and anything technical are the wrong place to chase numbers today.

If you do go, keep it lighter than normal: leave more reps in the tank, skip the max attempts, and cut it short if you feel foggy or off. An easy run or a shorter session is a fine middle ground. If you're wiped out, resting and getting a proper night's sleep tonight will do more for you than grinding through.

Want me to set up a lighter session for today?
